headline: Longevity News Roundup 2026 November 7th
author: Age and Biotech Explorations
text:
Longevity News Roundup 2026 November 7th

This week's Longevity News Roundup was made using AI (Claude Opus 4.8 wrote and fact-checked the script and built the slides; ChatGPT generated the images; Gemini TTS provided the voice). The script was cross-checked by two separate AI models against the source papers.

AI can make mistakes. Please verify any important details against the original sources linked below. This video is research commentary, not medical advice or a treatment recommendation.

Coverage: October 30 – November 6, 2026.

10:51 What we learned this week
11:42 Until next time
